about.description: Asseto is a blockchain-based platform providing infrastructure for tokenization and on-chain financial services. It enables users to access and trade diverse digital assets through decentralized protocols.
about.registryInfo: Asseto is a tokenization platform for fractional real-estate ownership. Issues tokens representing shares of single-property real-estate vehicles structured under Delaware Statutory Trusts or equivalent regulated entities.

fees.revenueNotes: Asseto earns acquisition / structuring fees on each property issuance + ongoing property-management fees (typical 8-10% of rental income).
